cases.title: Hanford brushfire change
cases.question: Where did visible change occur between these dates?
cases.expected_response_type: Conservative change summary with region statistics
cases.expected_behavior: Expected behavior: produce a model-generated change mask, changed-area statistics, and a cautious description of detected regions.
cases.purpose: Demonstrate the real bi-temporal workflow on an attributed public image pair.
limitations: No pixel-level reference mask is supplied; model output is not ground truth.
The model was trained primarily on building change and may not generalize to brushfire effects.
cases.source: NASA Earth Observatory — High-Resolution View of Hanford, Washington
cases.attribution: Image courtesy Ron Beck, USGS EROS Data Center
cases.license: U.S. government NASA/USGS imagery; source record carries no contrary copyright notice

cases.title: Large yellow vehicle grounding
cases.question: Locate the large yellow vehicle situated closest to the green area.
cases.expected_behavior: Reference context: the benchmark annotation supplies one target box; live execution must still use the production grounding pipeline.
cases.purpose: Demonstrate relation-aware VRSBench grounding with a repository evaluation asset.
limitations: The displayed reference context does not guarantee the live model will return the annotated box.
Grounding scores are not calibrated scientific confidence.
cases.license: VRSBench research-use dataset terms; retain source attribution

cases.title: Harbor at an image boundary
cases.question: Locate the harbor near the top-right corner extending into the water.
cases.expected_behavior: Reference context: the target annotation is clipped at the image boundary; live output may be null if quality gates reject all boxes.
cases.purpose: Expose a difficult clipped-boundary grounding case rather than only presenting easy successes.
limitations: The reference is an axis-aligned box derived from the official polygon and clipped to image bounds.
A null production result is preferable to an invented box when quality gates are not met.
